title: Sutra-khanda, part 7 (portion 07)
html:
Narada answers Brahma: on service to the Vaishnavas, on the hidden prema of the gopis and how the Lord will spread it in Kali; the rejoicing of the three worlds; Narada sees the coming of Kali, hears the voice of Jagannatha and comes to Nilachala; Jagannatha describes Goloka and sends him to Gaura; Narada with the Lord of Vaikuntha, who calls Himself a portion of Gaura; in Goloka Narada beholds the bathing of Gaurasundara

Raga sindhura

নারদ কহেন ব্রহ্মা কি কহিব আর ।
যে কিছু কহিলা এই হৃদয় আমার ॥ ৪৫০ ॥

nārada kahena brahmā ki kahiba āra |
ye kichu kahilā ei hṛdaẏa āmāra || 450 ||

narada kahena — Narada says; brahma — Brahma; ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; ye kichhu kahila — whatever you said; ei hridaya amara — this is my heart

450Narada says: "Brahma, what more shall I say?
All that you have said is my very heart.

কর্মবন্ধে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে কত কল্প ।
দৈবে বৈষ্ণবসেবা ঘটে যদি অল্প ॥ ৪৫১ ॥

karmabandhe bhramite bhramite kata kalpa |
daibe baiṣṇabasebā ghaṭe yadi alpa || 451 ||

karma-bandhe — in the bonds of karma; bhramite bhramite — wandering and wandering; kata kalpa — how many kalpas; daive — by fortune; vaishnava-seva — service to Vaishnavas; ghate yadi alpa — if a little befalls

451Wandering in the bonds of karma, [a soul] roams for so many kalpas!
If by fortune a little service to the Vaishnavas falls to its lot,

তার মহোত্তম কথা নিগূঢ় শুনিঞা ।
পালয়ে পরম যত্নে সাবধান হঞা ॥ ৪৫২ ॥

tāra mahottama kathā nigūṛha śuniñā |
pālaẏe parama yatne sābadhāna hañā || 452 ||

tara — their (the Vaishnavas'); mahottama katha nigudha — exalted secret word; shunina — having heard; palaye — keeps; parama yatne — with the utmost care; savadhana hana — attentively

452and it hears from them the exalted secret word,
then it keeps it with the utmost care, attentively.

তবে মুক্তবন্ধ হঞা কৃষ্ণপর হয় ।
সালোক্যাদি মুক্তি চারি অঙ্গুলে না ছোঁয় ॥ ৪৫৩ ॥

tabe muktabandha hañā kṛṣṇapara haẏa |
sālokyādi mukti cāri aṅgule nā choṁẏa || 453 ||

tabe — then; mukta-bandha hana — freed from bonds; krishna-para haya — becomes devoted to Krishna; salokya-adi mukti chari — the four liberations, salokya and the rest; angule na chhonya — does not touch with a finger

453Then, freed from bondage, it becomes devoted to Krishna
and will not touch with a finger the four liberations, salokya and the rest.

তার পর প্রেমভক্তি গোপিকার ভাব ।
কে আছয়ে অধিকারী সে সব আলাপ ॥ ৪৫৪ ॥

tāra para premabhakti gopikāra bhāba |
ke āchaẏe adhikārī se saba ālāpa || 454 ||

tara para — beyond that; prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti; gopikara bhava — the bhava of the gopis; ke achhaye adhikari — who is qualified; se saba alapa — [for] talk of all that

454And beyond that is prema-bhakti, the bhava of the gopis:
who is qualified even to speak of all that?

যাঁর রসে বশ প্রভু ত্রিজগতনাথ ।
প্রাকৃতজনের যেন কুলটার সাথ ॥ ৪৫৫ ॥

yāṁra rase baśa prabhu trijagatanātha |
prākṛtajanera yena kulaṭāra sātha || 455 ||

yanra rase — by whose rasa; vasha prabhu — the Lord is subdued; trijagata-natha — Master of the three worlds; prakrita-janera — to worldly people; yena kulatara satha — as if [consorting] with an unchaste woman

455By their rasa the Lord, the Master of the three worlds, is conquered —
yet to worldly people [their love] seems like consorting with an unchaste woman.1

তার প্রেমভক্তি-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
গুল্মলতা জন্ম উদ্ধব মাগে যার গুণে ॥ ৪৫৬ ॥

tāra premabhakti-kathā ke kahite jāne |
gulmalatā janma uddhaba māge yāra guṇe || 456 ||

tara prema-bhakti-katha — the tale of their prema-bhakti; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; gulma-lata janma — birth as a bush or creeper; uddhava mage — Uddhava begs; yara gune — for whose virtues

456Who can tell of their prema-bhakti?
For the sake of their virtues Uddhava begs to be born a bush or a creeper.

So in the Srimad-Bhagavata (10.47.61):

আসামহো চরণরেণুজুষামহং স্যাং
বৃন্দাবনে কিমপি গুল্মলতৌষধীনাম্ ।
যা দুস্ত্যজং স্বজনমার্যপথঞ্চ হিত্বা
ভেজুর্মুকুন্দপদবীং শ্রুতিভির্বিমৃগ্যাম্ ॥ ৪৫৭ ॥

āsāmaho caraṇareṇujuṣāmahaṃ syāṃ
bṛndābane kimapi gulmalatauṣadhīnām |
yā dustyajaṃ sbajanamāryapathañca hitbā
bhejurmukundapadabīṃ śrutibhirbimṛgyām || 457 ||

asam — of them (the gopis); aho — oh; charana-renu-jusham — serving the dust of the feet; aham syam — may I be; vrindavane — in Vrindavana; kim api — any one; gulma-lata-oshadhinam — of the bushes, creepers and herbs; ya — who; dustyajam svajanam — kinsmen hard to abandon; arya-patham cha — and the path of the noble; hitva — abandoning; bhejuh — attained; mukunda-padavim — the way of Mukunda; shrutibhih vimrigyam — sought by the shrutis

457'Oh, that I might be anything at all — a bush, a creeper or a herb — in Vrindavana,
[to serve] the dust of the feet of those who, abandoning kinsmen hard to abandon and the path of the noble,
attained the way of Mukunda, which the shrutis seek!'2

যে প্রভুর চরণ ব্রহ্মা মহেশ ধেয়ায় ।
যোগীন্দ্র মুনীন্দ্র খুঁজি উদ্দেশ না পায় ॥ ৪৫৮ ॥

ye prabhura caraṇa brahmā maheśa dheẏāẏa |
yogīndra munīndra khuṁji uddeśa nā pāẏa || 458 ||

ye prabhura charana — the feet of that Lord; brahma mahesha dheyaya — Brahma and Mahesha meditate on; yogindra munindra — the best of yogis and sages; khunji — searching; uddesha na paya — find no trace

458That Lord on whose feet Brahma and Mahesha meditate,
whom the best of yogis and sages seek and find not even a trace of;

অশেষ লখিমী যার করে পদসেবা ।
বাক্য-অগোচর যার পদমধু-প্রভা ॥ ৪৫৯ ॥

aśeṣa lakhimī yāra kare padasebā |
bākya-agocara yāra padamadhu-prabhā || 459 ||

ashesha lakhimi — countless Lakshmis; yara kare pada-seva — whose feet they serve; vakya-agochara — beyond the reach of words; yara pada-madhu-prabha — the honeyed radiance of whose feet

459whose feet are served by countless Lakshmis,
the honeyed radiance of whose feet is beyond the reach of words;

চারি বেদে যাঁহার মহত্ত্ব নিত্য গায় ।
অনন্ত মহিমা গুণ ওর নাহি পায় ॥ ৪৬০ ॥

cāri bede yāṁhāra mahattba nitya gāẏa |
ananta mahimā guṇa ora nāhi pāẏa || 460 ||

chari vede — the four Vedas; yanhara mahattva — whose greatness; nitya gaya — ever sing; ananta mahima guna — of the endless glory and virtues; ora nahi paya — find no limit

460whose greatness the four Vedas ever sing,
finding no limit to His endless glory and virtues;

শেষ মহাশয় যার শয়নের শয্যা ।
হেন প্রভু কৈল গোপিকার পরিচর্যা ॥ ৪৬১ ॥

śeṣa mahāśaẏa yāra śaẏanera śayyā |
hena prabhu kaila gopikāra paricaryā || 461 ||

shesha mahashaya — the great Shesha; yara shayanera shayya — whose bed for sleeping; hena prabhu — such a Lord; kaila gopikara paricharya — served the gopis

461whose bed is the great Shesha —
such a Lord served the gopis.

আর কত ভকত আছয়ে শত শত ।
হেন রূপে বশ কৈল গোপী অনুগত ॥ ৪৬২ ॥

āra kata bhakata āchaẏe śata śata |
hena rūpe baśa kaila gopī anugata || 462 ||

ara kata bhakata — how many other devotees; achhaye shata shata — there are hundreds; hena rupe — in such a way; vasha kaila — conquered; gopi — the gopis; anugata — [so that He became] obedient

462There are hundreds of other devotees too,
but only the gopis so conquered Him that He became obedient to them.

কোথা কৃষ্ণ পরমাত্মা নিগূঢ় যে প্রেমা ।
কোথা গোপী বনচারী ব্যভিচারী কামা ॥ ৪৬৩ ॥

kothā kṛṣṇa paramātmā nigūṛha ye premā |
kothā gopī banacārī byabhicārī kāmā || 463 ||

kotha krishna paramatma — where is Krishna, the Supreme Self; nigudha ye prema — and so hidden a prema; kotha gopi — where the gopis; vanachari — forest-dwellers; vyabhichari — unchaste; kama — lustful

463Where is Krishna, the Supreme Self — and so hidden a prema —
and where the gopis, forest-dwellers, 'unchaste', 'lustful'?3

এছন ভকতিতত্ত্ব বুঝিবারে চাই ।
পরম নিগূঢ় ভক্তি ইহা বই নাই ॥ ৪৬৪ ॥

echana bhakatitattba bujhibāre cāi |
parama nigūṛha bhakti ihā bai nāi || 464 ||

aichhana bhakati-tattva — such a truth of bhakti; bujhibare chai — I want to understand; parama nigudha bhakti — more hidden bhakti; iha bai nai — there is none but this

464Such is the truth of bhakti I long to understand:
there is no bhakti more hidden than this.

হেন ভক্তি প্রচারিব কলিযুগে প্রভু ।
লখিমী অনন্ত যাহা নাহি শুনে কভু ॥ ৪৬৫ ॥

hena bhakti pracāriba kaliyuge prabhu |
lakhimī ananta yāhā nāhi śune kabhu || 465 ||

hena bhakti — such bhakti; prachariba kali-yuge prabhu — the Lord will spread in the Kali-yuga; lakhimi ananta — Lakshmi and Ananta; yaha nahi shune kabhu — which they never heard of

465This bhakti the Lord will spread in the Kali-yuga —
that which even Lakshmi and Ananta have never heard of.

সভারে বোলহ ব্রহ্মা সব ব্রহ্মলোকে ।
নিজ নিজ অংশে জন্ম লহ কলিযুগে ॥ ৪৬৬ ॥

sabhāre bolaha brahmā saba brahmaloke |
nija nija aṃśe janma laha kaliyuge || 466 ||

sabhare bolaha — tell everyone; brahma — Brahma; saba brahmaloke — throughout Brahmaloka; nija nija amshe — each by his portion; janma laha kali-yuge — take birth in the Kali-yuga

466Tell everyone, Brahma, throughout Brahmaloka:
'Take birth by your portions in the Kali-yuga!'"

ইহা বলি মহামুনি অন্তর উল্লাস ।
চলিলা নারদ কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ৪৬৭ ॥

ihā bali mahāmuni antara ullāsa |
calilā nārada kahe e locanadāsa || 467 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahamuni — the great sage; antara ullasa — with jubilation in heart; chalila narada — Narada set out; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

467Having said this, with jubilation in his heart,
the great sage Narada went on his way, says this Lochana Dasa.

Raga mallara, tripadi metre; disha: "O my life, Gorachand!"4

চলিলা নারদমুনি, বীণার গর্জন শুনি,
লহু লহু শ্রবণমঙ্গল গীত না ।
অমিয় সিঞ্চিল যেন, জগতজনের মন,
ভুবনে আনন্দ-চমকিত না ॥ ৪৬৮ ॥

calilā nāradamuni, bīṇāra garjana śuni,
lahu lahu śrabaṇamaṅgala gīta nā |
amiẏa siñcila yena, jagatajanera mana,
bhubane ānanda-camakita nā || 468 ||

chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; vinara garjana shuni — the roar of the vina is heard; lahu lahu — softly; shravana-mangala gita — a song delightful to the ear; amiya sinchila yena — as if sprinkled nectar; jagata-janera mana — the minds of the world's people; bhuvane ananda-chamakita — the worlds thrilled with joy

468Narada Muni set out; the roar of his vina is heard,
softly flows a song that delights the ear;
as if it sprinkled nectar on the minds of the world's people —
the worlds thrilled with joy.

জয় জয় হরিবোল, আনন্দে মগন ভেল,
ঘোষণা পড়িল তিনলোকে না ।
অস্ত্র-পারিষদ-সঙ্গে, জনম লভিব রঙ্গে,
গোরা অবতার কলিযুগে না ॥ ৪৬৯ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa haribola, ānande magana bhela,
ghoṣaṇā paṛila tinaloke nā |
astra-pāriṣada-saṅge, janama labhiba raṅge,
gorā abatāra kaliyuge nā || 469 ||

jaya jaya haribola — "jaya, jaya, Haribol!"; anande magana bhela — were immersed in bliss; ghoshana padila tinaloke — a proclamation went through the three worlds; astra-parishada-sange — with weapons and associates; janama labhiba range — will joyfully take birth; gora avatara kali-yuge — Gora, the avatara in the Kali-yuga

469"Jaya, jaya! Haribol!" — all were immersed in bliss;
a proclamation went through the three worlds:
"With [His] weapons and associates, joyfully He will take birth —
Gora, the avatara for the Kali-yuga!

এছন করুণাকর, দেখিব নয়ান মোর,
অমিয়া সিঞ্চিব কলেবরে না ।
জয় জয় জগন্নাথ, ভকতজনের সাথ,
নিজভক্তি করিব প্রচার না ॥ ৪৭০ ॥

echana karuṇākara, dekhiba naẏāna mora,
amiẏā siñciba kalebare nā |
jaẏa jaẏa jagannātha, bhakatajanera sātha,
nijabhakti kariba pracāra nā || 470 ||

aichhana karunakara — such an ocean of mercy; dekhiba nayana mora — my eyes will see; amiya sinchiba kalevare — will sprinkle nectar on the body; jaya jaya jagannatha — jaya, jaya, Jagannatha; bhakata-janera satha — together with the devotees; nija-bhakti kariba prachara — will spread devotion to Himself

470Such an ocean of mercy my eyes will see;
He will sprinkle nectar on my body.
Jaya, jaya, Jagannatha! Together with the devotees
He will spread devotion to Himself.

কলিযুগ ধনি ধনি, লোক প্রজা সব ধনি,
অবনী নদীয়া তার মাঝে না ।
ধনি মিশ্র পুরন্দর, ভবনেতে যাহার,
জনম লভিলা গোরারাজে না ॥ ৪৭১ ॥

kaliyuga dhani dhani, loka prajā saba dhani,
abanī nadīẏā tāra mājhe nā |
dhani miśra purandara, bhabanete yāhāra,
janama labhilā gorārāje nā || 471 ||

kali-yuga dhani dhani — blessed is the Kali-yuga; loka praja saba dhani — blessed are all the people; avani — the earth; nadiya tara majhe — Nadiya upon it; dhani mishra purandara — blessed is Mishra Purandara; bhavanete yahara — in whose house; janama labhila gora-raja — Gora-raja has taken birth

471Blessed, blessed is the Kali-yuga, blessed are all its people,
[blessed] the earth, and Nadia upon it;
blessed is Mishra Purandara, in whose house
Gora-raja has taken birth.5

এই ভকতসঙ্গে, হরিগুণ-গান রঙ্গে,
বায় শঙ্খ মৃদঙ্গ করতাল না ।
এ ভুবন চতুর্দশ, প্রেম-বরিষণ-রস,
গুণকীর্তন করিব পরচার না ॥ ৪৭২ ॥

ei bhakatasaṅge, hariguṇa-gāna raṅge,
bāẏa śaṅkha mṛdaṅga karatāla nā |
e bhubana caturdaśa, prema-bariṣaṇa-rasa,
guṇakīrtana kariba paracāra nā || 472 ||

ei bhakata-sange — with these devotees; hariguna-gana range — joyfully singing Hari's virtues; vaya shankha mridanga karatala — conches, mridangas and kartals sound; e bhuvana chaturdasha — these fourteen worlds; prema-barishana-rasa — the rasa of the rain of prema; guna-kirtana kariba parachara — will spread the kirtana of virtues

472With these devotees, joyfully singing the virtues of Hari —
conches, mridangas and kartals sounding —
through the fourteen worlds, raining down the rasa of prema,
He will spread the kirtana of [His] virtues.

বৃন্দাবন-গুণ-রস, প্রণয় সে সরবস,
আপনে আস্বাদি দিব সভে না ।
দেব-নাগ-নরগণে, আচণ্ডাল সব জনে,
পিয়াইব যাহা করি লোভে না ॥ ৪৭৩ ॥

bṛndābana-guṇa-rasa, praṇaẏa se sarabasa,
āpane āsbādi diba sabhe nā |
deba-nāga-naragaṇe, ācaṇḍāla saba jane,
piẏāiba yāhā kari lobhe nā || 473 ||

vrindavana-guna-rasa — the rasa of Vrindavana's virtues; pranaya se sarabasa — love, which is all in all; apane asvadi — tasting Himself; diba sabhe — will give to all; deva-naga-naragane — to gods, nagas and men; achandala saba jane — to all down to the chandala; piyaiba — will give to drink; yaha kari lobhe — that for which He awakens their thirst

473The rasa of the virtues of Vrindavana — love, which is all in all —
He will taste Himself and give to all;
to gods, nagas and men, to everyone down to the chandala,
He will give to drink that for which He awakens their thirst."

আনন্দে আনন্দ গুণ, মঙ্গলে মঙ্গল শুন,
বৃন্দাবন-ধন পরকাশ না ।
সকল-ভুবনপতি, জনম লভিল ক্ষিতি,
আনন্দে ভুলিল এ লোচনদাস না ॥ ৪৭৪ ॥

ānande ānanda guṇa, maṅgale maṅgala śuna,
bṛndābana-dhana parakāśa nā |
sakala-bhubanapati, janama labhila kṣiti,
ānande bhulila e locanadāsa nā || 474 ||

anande ananda guna — bliss upon bliss are the virtues; mangale mangala shuna — good upon good, hear; vrindavana-dhana parakasha — the treasure of Vrindavana revealed; sakala-bhuvanapati — the Lord of all the worlds; janama labhila kshiti — has taken birth on earth; anande bhulila e lochanadasa — in bliss this Lochana Dasa forgot himself

474Bliss upon bliss are [His] virtues; hear: good upon good —
the treasure of Vrindavana is revealed;
the Lord of all the worlds has taken birth on earth —
in bliss this Lochana Dasa forgot himself.

Raga varadi; disha: "My Lord, O my life, oh, Gorachand!"

যোগী মুনীন্দ্র ইন্দ্র চন্দ্র আদি লোকে ।
শুনিঞা আনন্দময় নাচয়ে কৌতুকে ॥ ৪৭৫ ॥

yogī munīndra indra candra ādi loke |
śuniñā ānandamaẏa nācaẏe kautuke || 475 ||

yogi munindra indra chandra adi loke — yogis, great sages, Indra, Chandra and the rest in the worlds; shunina — hearing; anandamaya — full of bliss; nachaye kautuke — dance in delight

475Yogis, great sages, Indra, Chandra and the rest in their worlds,
hearing [the news], filled with bliss, dance in delight.

নারদ আনন্দময় ভ্রময়ে কৌতুকে ।
অঙ্কুরিত মৃততরু যেন দেখে লোকে ॥ ৪৭৬ ॥

nārada ānandamaẏa bhramaẏe kautuke |
aṅkurita mṛtataru yena dekhe loke || 476 ||

narada anandamaya — Narada, full of bliss; bhramaye kautuke — roams in delight; ankurita mrita-taru — a dead tree that has sprouted; yena dekhe loke — as if people see

476Narada, full of bliss, roams in delight —
it seems to people as if a dead tree had put forth shoots.

হেনমতে ভ্রমিতে ভ্রমিতে আচম্বিত ।
ধর্মবিপর্যয় দেখে লোকের চরিত ॥ ৪৭৭ ॥

henamate bhramite bhramite ācambita |
dharmabiparyaẏa dekhe lokera carita || 477 ||

henamate — thus; bhramite bhramite — roaming; achambita — suddenly; dharma-viparyaya — the overturning of dharma; dekhe lokera charita — sees in people's conduct

477Roaming thus, he suddenly
sees that dharma has been overturned in people's conduct:

দান ব্রত তপস্যা ছাড়িয়া সর্বজন ।
স্ত্রীয়ের গৌরব করে কায়-বাক্য-মন ॥ ৪৭৮ ॥

dāna brata tapasyā chāṛiẏā sarbajana |
strīẏera gauraba kare kāẏa-bākya-mana || 478 ||

dana vrata tapasya — charity, vows, austerity; chhadiya sarvajana — abandoning, all people; striyera gaurava kare — honour their wives; kaya-vakya-mana — with body, speech and mind

478abandoning charity, vows and austerity, all people
with body, speech and mind honour [only] their wives.6

ইহা অনুমানি মুনি জানিল নিশ্চয় ।
এই কলিযুগ ইথে নাহিক সংশয় ॥ ৪৭৯ ॥

ihā anumāni muni jānila niścaẏa |
ei kaliyuga ithe nāhika saṃśaẏa || 479 ||

iha anumani — reflecting on this; muni janila nishchaya — the sage knew for certain; ei kali-yuga — this is the Kali-yuga; ithe nahika samshaya — there is no doubt of it

479Reflecting on this, the sage knew for certain:
this is the Kali-yuga, there is no doubt of it.

যা লাগিয়া তিন লোকে ঘোষণা পড়িল ।
কারে নিবেদিব এই কলিযুগ আইল ॥ ৪৮০ ॥

yā lāgiẏā tina loke ghoṣaṇā paṛila |
kāre nibediba ei kaliyuga āila || 480 ||

ya lagiya — for which; tina loke ghoshana padila — a proclamation went through the three worlds; kare nivediba — to whom shall I tell; ei kali-yuga aila — here the Kali-yuga has come

480"That for which a proclamation went through the three worlds —
to whom shall I tell it? — here it is, the Kali-yuga has come!"

চিন্তিত হইয়া মুনি বসিলা ধেয়ানে ।
আচম্বিতে শুভবাণী উঠিল গগনে ॥ ৪৮১ ॥

cintita haiẏā muni basilā dheẏāne |
ācambite śubhabāṇī uṭhila gagane || 481 ||

chintita haiya — becoming troubled; muni basila dheyane — the sage sat in meditation; achambite — suddenly; shubha-vani uthila gagane — an auspicious voice arose in the sky

481Troubled, the sage sat down in meditation,
and suddenly an auspicious voice arose in the sky:

জগন্নাথ দারুব্রহ্ম আমি নীলাচলে ।
লোক-নিস্তারণ-হেতু সমুদ্রের কূলে ॥ ৪৮২ ॥

jagannātha dārubrahma āmi nīlācale |
loka-nistāraṇa-hetu samudrera kūle || 482 ||

jagannatha — Jagannatha; daru-brahma — Brahman in wood; ami nilachale — I [am] in Nilachala; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; samudrera kule — on the shore of the ocean

482"I am Jagannatha, the Daru-brahman,7 in Nilachala,
on the shore of the ocean, for the deliverance of people.

পূর্ববৃত্তান্ত নাহি স্মরণ যে তোর ।
কাত্যায়নী-প্রতিজ্ঞায় আজ্ঞা পাইলে মোর ॥ ৪৮৩ ॥

pūrbabṛttānta nāhi smaraṇa ye tora |
kātyāẏanī-pratijñāẏa ājñā pāile mora || 483 ||

purva-vrittanta — the former account; nahi smarana ye tora — do you not remember; katyayani-pratijnaya — through Katyayani's vow; ajna paile mora — you received My command

483Do you not remember the former account?
Through Katyayani's vow you received My command.8

চল চল মুনিরাজ নীলাচলপুরী ।
আচরিহ জগন্নাথ-আজ্ঞা-অনুসারি ॥ ৪৮৪ ॥

cala cala munirāja nīlācalapurī |
ācariha jagannātha-ājñā-anusāri || 484 ||

chala chala — go, go; muniraja — king of sages; nilachala-puri — to the city of Nilachala; achariha — act; jagannatha-ajna-anusari — according to Jagannatha's command

484Go, go, king of sages, to the city of Nilachala
and act according to the command of Jagannatha."

চলিলা নারদমুনি আনন্দ হিয়ায় ।
উঠিল বীণার ধ্বনি জগত জড়ায় ॥ ৪৮৫ ॥

calilā nāradamuni ānanda hiẏāẏa |
uṭhila bīṇāra dhbani jagata jaṛāẏa || 485 ||

chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; ananda hiyaya — with joy in his heart; uthila vinara dhvani — the sound of the vina arose; jagata jadaya — enfolding the world

485Narada Muni set out with joy in his heart;
the sound of his vina arose, filling the world.

হাহা জগন্নাথ বলি অনুরাগে ধায় ।
দেখিল শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র ত্রিজগতরায় ॥ ৪৮৬ ॥

hāhā jagannātha bali anurāge dhāẏa |
dekhila śrīmukhacandra trijagatarāẏa || 486 ||

haha jagannatha bali — crying "Ha, ha, Jagannatha!"; anurage dhaya — runs in love; dekhila shri-mukha-chandra — saw the moon-like face; trijagata-raya — of the King of the three worlds

486Crying "Ha, ha, Jagannatha!" he runs in love
and beheld the moon-like face of the King of the three worlds —

যত অবতার তার আশ্রয়-সদন ।
সব-কলা-রসময় প্রসন্ন বদন ॥ ৪৮৭ ॥

yata abatāra tāra āśraẏa-sadana |
saba-kalā-rasamaẏa prasanna badana || 487 ||

yata avatara — of all the avataras; tara ashraya-sadana — their shelter and abode; saba-kala-rasamaya — full of the rasa of all arts; prasanna vadana — a gracious face

487the abode and shelter of all avataras,
a gracious face full of the rasa of all arts.

চরণে পড়িয়া মুনি বোলে কর জুড়ি ।
কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ আইল যুগ কলি ॥ ৪৮৮ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā muni bole kara juṛi |
kṛpā kara jagannātha āila yuga kali || 488 ||

charane padiya — falling at the feet; muni bole kara judi — the sage says with joined palms; kripa kara jagannatha — be merciful, Jagannatha; aila yuga kali — the Kali-yuga has come

488Falling at His feet, the sage says with joined palms:
"Be merciful, Jagannatha — the Kali-yuga has come!

মহাঘোর পাপেতে পড়িল সব লোকে ।
শিশ্নোদর-পরায়ণ ভ্রান্ত মহাশোকে ॥ ৪৮৯ ॥

mahāghora pāpete paṛila saba loke |
śiśnodara-parāẏaṇa bhrānta mahāśoke || 489 ||

mahaghora papete — into the most terrible sin; padila saba loke — all people have fallen; shishnodara-parayana — devoted to lust and belly; bhranta — gone astray; mahashoke — in great sorrow

489All people have fallen into the most terrible sin;
devoted to lust and belly, they have gone astray, in great sorrow."

শুনিঞা ঠাকুর কিছু হাসিয়া কহিল ।
কর পরশিয়া তারে নিভৃতে কহিল ॥ ৪৯০ ॥

śuniñā ṭhākura kichu hāsiẏā kahila |
kara paraśiẏā tāre nibhṛte kahila || 490 ||

shunina — hearing; thakura — the Lord; kichhu hasiya kahila — smiling a little, spoke; kara parashiya tare — touching him with His hand; nibhrite kahila — told in private

490Hearing this, the Lord, smiling a little, spoke;
touching him with His hand, He told him in private:

পরম নিগূঢ় এই কহি তোর স্থানে ।
গোলোকে চলহ তুমি আমার বচনে ॥ ৪৯১ ॥

parama nigūṛha ei kahi tora sthāne |
goloke calaha tumi āmāra bacane || 491 ||

parama nigudha ei — this supreme secret; kahi tora sthane — I tell you; goloke chalaha tumi — go to Goloka; amara vachane — at My word

491"I tell you this supreme secret:
at My word go to Goloka.

Raga pahida, tripadi metre

বৈকুণ্ঠ-উপরি স্থান, গোলোক যাহার নাম,
শ্রীগৌরসুন্দর তাহে রাজা ।
লখিমী-আদিক নারী, একই পুরুষ হরি,
সুখময় সকল পরজা ॥ ৪৯২ ॥

baikuṇṭha-upari sthāna, goloka yāhāra nāma,
śrīgaurasundara tāhe rājā |
lakhimī-ādika nārī, ekai puruṣa hari,
sukhamaẏa sakala parajā || 492 ||

vaikuntha-upari sthana — an abode above Vaikuntha; goloka yahara nama — whose name is Goloka; shri-gaurasundara tahe raja — Sri Gaurasundara is king there; lakhimi-adika nari — the women are Lakshmi and the others; ekai purusha hari — the one Purusha is Hari; sukhamaya sakala paraja — all the subjects are full of happiness

492Above Vaikuntha there is an abode whose name is Goloka;
Sri Gaurasundara is king there;9
the women are Lakshmi and the others, the one Purusha is Hari,
and all the subjects are full of happiness.

রাধা আর রুক্মিণী, এই দুই ঠাকুরাণী,
তার অংশে যতেক নাগরী ।
শত শত শাখা-ভক্তি, এ দোঁহার ধরি শক্তি,
সেবা করে হঞা অনুচরী ॥ ৪৯৩ ॥

rādhā āra rukmiṇī, ei dui ṭhākurāṇī,
tāra aṃśe yateka nāgarī |
śata śata śākhā-bhakti, e doṁhāra dhari śakti,
sebā kare hañā anucarī || 493 ||

radha ara rukmini — Radha and Rukmini; ei dui thakurani — these two queens; tara amshe yateka nagari — all the nagaris are their portions; shata shata shakha-bhakti — hundreds of branches of bhakti; e donhara dhari shakti — holding the power of these two; seva kare hana anuchari — serve as attendants

493Radha and Rukmini — these two queens;
all the nagaris are their portions;
hundreds upon hundreds of branches of bhakti, holding the power of these two,
serve [Him] as their attendants.10

আর দেবী সত্যভামা, রূপে গুণে অনুপমা,
সব বৈদগ্ধী-রস-সীমা ।
লীলা-বিলাস-লাবণ্য, সর্ব-কলা-রসে ধন্যা,
ত্রিজগতে রমণী পরমা ॥ ৪৯৪ ॥

āra debī satyabhāmā, rūpe guṇe anupamā,
saba baidagdhī-rasa-sīmā |
līlā-bilāsa-lābaṇya, sarba-kalā-rase dhanyā,
trijagate ramaṇī paramā || 494 ||

ara devi satyabhama — and the goddess Satyabhama; rupe gune anupama — incomparable in beauty and virtue; saba vaidagdhi-rasa-sima — the limit of the rasa of all wit; lila-vilasa-lavanya — with lila, play, loveliness; sarva-kala-rase dhanya — blessed with the rasa of all arts; trijagate ramani parama — the supreme woman of the three worlds

494And the goddess Satyabhama, incomparable in beauty and virtue,
the limit of the rasa of all clever wit;
blessed with lila, play and loveliness, with the rasa of all arts —
the supreme woman of the three worlds.

সঙ্গীত বলিয়ে যারে, তাল-সঞ্চারণ স্বরে,
শব্দব্রহ্ম জগতে বাখানে ।
বলিয়ে পঞ্চম বেদ, যে বুঝয়ে স্বরভেদ,
বুদ্ধিরূপা সর্বত্র সমানে ॥ ৪৯৫ ॥

saṅgīta baliẏe yāre, tāla-sañcāraṇa sbare,
śabdabrahma jagate bākhāne |
baliẏe pañcama beda, ye bujhaẏe sbarabheda,
buddhirūpā sarbatra samāne || 495 ||

sangita baliye yare — she who is called Music; tala-sancharana svare — with rhythm and movement of tones; shabda-brahma jagate bakhane — the world praises as Shabda-brahman; baliye panchama veda — she is called the fifth Veda; ye bujhaye svarabheda — [for one] who understands the distinction of notes; buddhi-rupa — in the form of understanding; sarvatra samane — equally everywhere

495She who is called Music — with rhythm and the movement of tones —
the world praises as Shabda-brahman;
she is called the fifth Veda — [for one] who understands the distinctions of notes —
she is understanding itself, present equally in all.11

পুরুষ ঠাকুর-অংশ, সকল বৈষ্ণব-বংশ,
রসময় রঙ্গ-নামা পুরী ।
এছন মহিমা তার, কহিতে শকতি কার,
এক-মুখে কহিতে না পারি ॥ ৪৯৬ ॥

puruṣa ṭhākura-aṃśa, sakala baiṣṇaba-baṃśa,
rasamaẏa raṅga-nāmā purī |
echana mahimā tāra, kahite śakati kāra,
eka-mukhe kahite nā pāri || 496 ||

purusha thakura-amsha — the men are portions of the Lord; sakala vaishnava-vamsha — all of Vaishnava lineage; rasamaya — full of rasa; ranga-nama puri — the city named Ranga; aichhana mahima tara — such is its greatness; kahite shakati kara — who has the power to tell; eka-mukhe kahite na pari — I cannot tell with one mouth

496The men are portions of the Lord, all of Vaishnava lineage;
the city, full of rasa, is named Ranga.12
Such is the greatness of that [abode] — who has the power to tell it?
I cannot tell it with one mouth.

যতেক গোপিকাগণে, রাস কৈল বৃন্দাবনে,
রাধা আগে করি করে সেবা ।
দ্বারকায় আছিল যত, রুক্মিণীর অনুগত,
আর যত রস-অনুভবা ॥ ৪৯৭ ॥

yateka gopikāgaṇe, rāsa kaila bṛndābane,
rādhā āge kari kare sebā |
dbārakāẏa āchila yata, rukmiṇīra anugata,
āra yata rasa-anubhabā || 497 ||

yateka gopikagane — all the gopis; rasa kaila vrindavane — who danced the rasa in Vrindavana; radha age kari — placing Radha at their head; kare seva — serve; dvarakaya achhila yata — all who were in Dvaraka; rukminira anugata — follow Rukmini; ara yata rasa-anubhava — and all others who taste rasa

497All the gopis who danced the rasa in Vrindavana
serve [Him] with Radha at their head;
all who were in Dvaraka follow Rukmini —
and all the others who taste rasa.

ভক্তি বিনু নাহি তায়, নিরবধি যশঃ গায়,
স্বতন্ত্র হইয়া পরাধীন ।
মুক্ত পুনঃ সর্বজন, প্রাকৃতজনের হেন,
ভকতি করয়ে যেন দীন ॥ ৪৯৮ ॥

bhakti binu nāhi tāẏa, nirabadhi yaśaḥ gāẏa,
sbatantra haiẏā parādhīna |
mukta punaḥ sarbajana, prākṛtajanera hena,
bhakati karaẏe yena dīna || 498 ||

bhakti vinu nahi taya — there is nothing there but bhakti; niravadhi yashah gaya — unceasingly they sing [His] glory; svatantra haiya paradhina — though independent, dependent; mukta punah sarvajana — all are liberated, and yet; prakrita-janera hena — like ordinary people; bhakati karaye yena dina — practise bhakti as if humble

498There is nothing there but bhakti; unceasingly they sing [His] glory;
though independent, they are dependent [on Him];
all are liberated, and yet, like ordinary people,
they practise bhakti as if humble.

সালোক্যাদি চারি মুক্তি, বৈকুণ্ঠনাথের শক্তি,
ভক্তিহীন আপনে স্বতন্ত্র ।
লখিমী-সম্পদময়, দীনভাব নাহি রয়,
ভকতি কেবল পরতন্ত্র ॥ ৪৯৯ ॥

sālokyādi cāri mukti, baikuṇṭhanāthera śakti,
bhaktihīna āpane sbatantra |
lakhimī-sampadamaẏa, dīnabhāba nāhi raẏa,
bhakati kebala paratantra || 499 ||

salokya-adi chari mukti — the four liberations, salokya and the rest; vaikunthanathera shakti — the power of the Lord of Vaikuntha; bhakti-hina — devoid of bhakti; apane svatantra — independent in themselves; lakhimi-sampadamaya — full of Lakshmi's riches; dina-bhava nahi raya — keep no humility; bhakati kevala paratantra — bhakti alone depends on Another

499The four liberations, salokya and the rest, are the power of the Lord of Vaikuntha;
devoid of bhakti, they are independent in themselves;
full of the riches of Lakshmi, they keep no humility —
bhakti alone depends on Another.

শর্করা সে আপনে, নিজ স্বাদ নাহি জানে,
পর জন করে উপভোগ ।
এছন মুকতি-পদ, ভক্তিপথে দেই বাধ,
সব-পর প্রেমভক্তিযোগ ॥ ৫০০ ॥

śarkarā se āpane, nija sbāda nāhi jāne,
para jana kare upabhoga |
echana mukati-pada, bhaktipathe dei bādha,
saba-para premabhaktiyoga || 500 ||

sharkara se apane — sugar itself; nija svada nahi jane — does not know its own taste; para jana kare upabhoga — another enjoys it; aichhana mukati-pada — such is the station of liberation; bhakti-pathe dei badha — it bars the path of bhakti; saba-para prema-bhakti-yoga — above all is the yoga of prema-bhakti

500Sugar itself does not know its own sweetness —
another enjoys it;
such is the station of liberation: it bars the path of bhakti —
above all is the yoga of prema-bhakti.

বিধাতার অগোচর, সে পুরী আমার ঘর,
দয়ার কারণে আইলু এথা ।
শ্রীচৈতন্য সর্বেশ্বর, গৌর দীর্ঘ কলেবর,
দেখিয়া ঘুচাহ মনোব্যথা ॥ ৫০১ ॥

bidhātāra agocara, se purī āmāra ghara,
daẏāra kāraṇe āilu ethā |
śrīcaitanya sarbeśbara, gaura dīrgha kalebara,
dekhiẏā ghucāha manobyathā || 501 ||

vidhatara agochara — beyond the reach of the Creator; se puri amara ghara — that abode is My home; dayara karane ailu etha — out of mercy I came here; shri-chaitanya sarveshvara — Sri Chaitanya, Lord of all; gaura dirgha kalevara — golden, tall of body; dekhiya ghuchaha manovyatha — seeing Him, dispel the pain of your heart

501That abode, beyond the reach of the Creator, is My home;
out of mercy I have come here.
Behold Sri Chaitanya, the Lord of all, golden and tall of stature,
and the pain of your heart will go.

যে রূপে দেখিবে তথা, সে রূপে আসিব হেথা,
গুণকীর্তন করিব প্রচার ।
ঘুচাব সকল দুঃখ, প্রচারিব প্রেমসুখ,
কলিলোক করিব নিস্তার ॥ ৫০২ ॥

ye rūpe dekhibe tathā, se rūpe āsiba hethā,
guṇakīrtana kariba pracāra |
ghucāba sakala duḥkha, pracāriba premasukha,
kaliloka kariba nistāra || 502 ||

ye rupe dekhibe tatha — in whatever form you see there; se rupe asiba hetha — in that form I shall come here; guna-kirtana kariba prachara — I shall spread the kirtana of virtues; ghuchaba sakala duhkha — I shall remove all suffering; prachariba prema-sukha — I shall spread the joy of prema; kali-loka kariba nistara — I shall deliver the people of Kali

502In whatever form you see Me there, in that form I shall come here;
I shall spread the kirtana of [My] virtues,
remove all suffering, spread the joy of prema
and deliver the people of Kali."

চলিলা নারদমুনি, শুনি অপরূপ বাণী,
বেদ-অগোচর এই কথা ।
বৈকুণ্ঠ-উপর আর, গোলোক দেখিব যার,
সকল ভুবনে গুণগাথা ॥ ৫০৩ ॥

calilā nāradamuni, śuni aparūpa bāṇī,
beda-agocara ei kathā |
baikuṇṭha-upara āra, goloka dekhiba yāra,
sakala bhubane guṇagāthā || 503 ||

chalila naradamuni — Narada Muni set out; shuni aparupa vani — hearing wondrous words; veda-agochara ei katha — this speech is beyond the Vedas; vaikuntha-upara ara — above Vaikuntha, further; goloka dekhiba — I shall see Goloka; yara sakala bhuvane guna-gatha — whose glory is sung in all worlds

503Narada Muni set out, having heard these wondrous words:
"This speech is beyond the reach of the Vedas:
above Vaikuntha, further still, I shall see Goloka,
whose glory is sung in all the worlds.

মুক্তি পরমুক্তি আর, ভাগবত-বিচার,
শুনিল নিগূঢ় যত কথা ।
লোক-বেদ-অবিদিত, অবিদিত অবেকত,
বেকত দেখিব আজি তথা ॥ ৫০৪ ॥

mukti paramukti āra, bhāgabata-bicāra,
śunila nigūṛha yata kathā |
loka-beda-abidita, abidita abekata,
bekata dekhiba āji tathā || 504 ||

mukti paramukti ara — of liberation and supreme liberation; bhagavata-vichara — the reasoning of the Bhagavata; shunila nigudha yata katha — I have heard all secret words; loka-veda-avidita — unknown to the world and Vedas; avidita abekata — unknown, unmanifest; bekata dekhiba aji tatha — today I shall see it manifest there

504Of liberation and supreme liberation, of the reasoning of the Bhagavata
I have heard all the secret words;
what is unknown to the world and the Vedas, unknown, unmanifest —
today I shall see it manifest there."

অনুরাগে ধায় মুনি, বীণার শবদ শুনি,
বৈকুণ্ঠের প্রজা হরষিত ।
বৈকুণ্ঠের দ্বারে গিয়া, আনন্দে বিহ্বল হঞা,
সুমঙ্গল গায় গুণগীত ॥ ৫০৫ ॥

anurāge dhāẏa muni, bīṇāra śabada śuni,
baikuṇṭhera prajā haraṣita |
baikuṇṭhera dbāre giẏā, ānande bihbala hañā,
sumaṅgala gāẏa guṇagīta || 505 ||

anurage dhaya muni — in love the sage runs; vinara shabada shuni — the sound of the vina is heard; vaikunthera praja harashita — the people of Vaikuntha rejoiced; vaikunthera dvare giya — reaching the gate of Vaikuntha; anande vihvala hana — overwhelmed with bliss; sumangala gaya guna-gita — sings an auspicious song of virtues

505In love the sage runs; the sound of his vina is heard —
the people of Vaikuntha rejoiced;
reaching the gate of Vaikuntha, overwhelmed with bliss,
he sings an auspicious song of [His] virtues.

দেখিল বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ, সব পারিষদ-সাথ,
বসিয়াছে রত্নসিংহাসনে ।
পড়িয়া চরণতলে, মুনি পরণাম করে,
তুলি পহুঁ কৈল আলিঙ্গনে ॥ ৫০৬ ॥

dekhila baikuṇṭhanātha, saba pāriṣada-sātha,
basiẏāche ratnasiṃhāsane |
paṛiẏā caraṇatale, muni paraṇāma kare,
tuli pahuṁ kaila āliṅgane || 506 ||

dekhila vaikunthanatha — he saw the Lord of Vaikuntha; saba parishada-satha — with all associates; basiyachhe ratna-simhasane — seated on a jewelled throne; padiya charanatale — falling at the feet; muni paranama kare — the sage bows; tuli panhu kaila alingane — the Lord, raising him, embraced him

506He saw the Lord of Vaikuntha with all His associates,
seated on a jewelled throne;
falling at His feet, the sage bows down,
and the Lord, raising him, embraced him.

হাসি হাসি কহে পহুঁ, কি তোর অন্তরে রহুঁ,
কহ মুনি হৃদয় সত্বরে ।
উৎকণ্ঠ হৃদয়ে মোর, পালিব বচন তোর,
অগোচর করিব গোচরে ॥ ৫০৭ ॥

hāsi hāsi kahe pahuṁ, ki tora antare rahuṁ,
kaha muni hṛdaẏa satbare |
utkaṇṭha hṛdaẏe mora, pāliba bacana tora,
agocara kariba gocare || 507 ||

hasi hasi kahe panhu — smiling, the Lord says; ki tora antare rahu — what is in your heart; kaha muni hridaya satvare — tell quickly, sage, your mind; utkantha hridaye mora — My heart is eager; paliba vachana tora — I shall fulfil your word; agochara kariba gochare — I shall make the unseen seen

507Smiling, the Lord says: "What is in your heart?
Tell Me quickly, sage, what is in your mind.
My heart is eager: I shall fulfil your word,
I shall make the unseen seen."

করযোড়ে বোলে মুনি, তুমি সর্ব-অন্তর্যামী,
তোরে মুঞি কি বলিব আর ।
দারুব্রহ্মরূপে মোরে, যে কহিলে অন্তরে,
সেই রূপ দেখিব তোমার ॥ ৫০৮ ॥

karayoṛe bole muni, tumi sarba-antaryāmī,
tore muñi ki baliba āra |
dārubrahmarūpe more, ye kahile antare,
sei rūpa dekhiba tomāra || 508 ||

karajode bole muni — with joined palms the sage says; tumi sarva-antaryami — You are the Indweller of all; tore munji ki baliba ara — what more shall I tell You; daru-brahma-rupe more — in the form of the Daru-brahman, to me; ye kahile antare — of which You spoke within; sei rupa dekhiba tomara — that form of Yours I shall see

508With joined palms the sage says: "You are the Indweller of all,
what more shall I tell You?
That form of Yours of which You told me within, in the form of the Daru-brahman —
that is what I [wish] to see."

পুনঃ কহে গুণমণি, নিভৃতে কহিয়ে আমি,
সেই রূপ সহজ-স্বরূপে ।
তার মায়া ছায়া যত, অবতার শত শত,
আরাধয়ে পরম উদ্যোগে ॥ ৫০৯ ॥

punaḥ kahe guṇamaṇi, nibhṛte kahiẏe āmi,
sei rūpa sahaja-sbarūpe |
tāra māẏā chāẏā yata, abatāra śata śata,
ārādhaẏe parama udyoge || 509 ||

punah kahe gunamani — again the Jewel of virtues says; nibhrite kahiye ami — I tell you in private; sei rupa sahaja-svarupe — that form is the innate, original form; tara maya chhaya yata — His maya, all His reflections; avatara shata shata — hundreds of avataras; aradhaye parama udyoge — worship with the greatest zeal

509Again the Jewel of virtues says: "I tell you in private:
that form is [My] original, innate form;
His maya,13 His reflections — hundreds of avataras —
worship Him with the greatest zeal.

যার কায়ব্যূহ আমি, ব্যাপিত সকল ভূমি,
সর্বময় বিষ্ণু সর্বসর্ব ।
লক্ষ্মী মোর অনুচরী, আর যেই মুক্তি চারি,
তাহা আর কহিয়ে সন্দর্ভ ॥ ৫১০ ॥

yāra kāẏabyūha āmi, byāpita sakala bhūmi,
sarbamaẏa biṣṇu sarbasarba |
lakṣmī mora anucarī, āra yei mukti cāri,
tāhā āra kahiẏe sandarbha || 510 ||

yara kaya-vyuha ami — I am His bodily expansion; vyapita sakala bhumi — pervading all lands; sarvamaya vishnu sarva-sarva — the all-pervading Vishnu, all in all; lakshmi mora anuchari — Lakshmi is My attendant; ara yei mukti chari — and the four liberations; taha ara kahiye sandarbha — that connection too I tell

510I am His bodily expansion, pervading all lands,
the all-pervading Vishnu, all in all;
Lakshmi is My attendant, and the four liberations too —
this connection also I tell you.

যার অংশ বিষ্ণু আমি, সম্পদ হয় লখিমিনী,
বৈকুণ্ঠের অংশ এ বৈকুণ্ঠ ।
মুক্তি-ছায়া চারি মুক্তি, সবে আবরিয়া ভক্তি,
সেবে নাথ সে পহুঁ বৈকুণ্ঠ ॥ ৫১১ ॥

yāra aṃśa biṣṇu āmi, sampada haẏa lakhiminī,
baikuṇṭhera aṃśa e baikuṇṭha |
mukti-chāẏā cāri mukti, sabe ābariẏā bhakti,
sebe nātha se pahuṁ baikuṇṭha || 511 ||

yara amsha vishnu ami — I, Vishnu, am His portion; sampada haya lakhimini — Lakshmi is [His] wealth; vaikunthera amsha e vaikuntha — this Vaikuntha is a portion of [His] Vaikuntha; mukti-chhaya chari mukti — the four liberations are a shadow of freedom; sabe avariya bhakti — all, clothed in bhakti; seve natha — serve the Master; se panhu vaikuntha — that Lord of Vaikuntha

511I, Vishnu, am His portion; Lakshmi is [His] wealth;
this Vaikuntha is a portion of [His] Vaikuntha;
the four liberations are a shadow of [true] freedom; all, clothed in bhakti,
serve that Master — that Lord of Vaikuntha.14

রাধা মাত্র প্রকৃতি, প্রেমময় আকৃতি,
যার বশ পুরুষ প্রধান ।
বৈকুণ্ঠের এক ধাম, মহাবৈকুণ্ঠ যার নাম,
তিন গুণ শকতি সন্ধান ॥ ৫১২ ॥

rādhā mātra prakṛti, premamaẏa ākṛti,
yāra baśa puruṣa pradhāna |
baikuṇṭhera eka dhāma, mahābaikuṇṭha yāra nāma,
tina guṇa śakati sandhāna || 512 ||

radha matra prakriti — Radha alone is prakriti; premamaya akriti — Her form is prema; yara vasha purusha pradhana — to Her the supreme Purusha is subject; vaikunthera eka dhama — in Vaikuntha one abode; maha-vaikuntha yara nama — named Maha-Vaikuntha; tina guna shakati sandhana — the union of the three qualities of shakti (sense obscure)

512Radha alone is the prakriti, Her form is prema itself;
to Her the supreme Purusha is subject;
in Vaikuntha there is one abode named Maha-Vaikuntha —
there is the union of the three qualities of shakti.15

নিশ্চয় বচন মোরি, অমায়া সে গৌরহরি,
প্রকট করুণা-কল্পতরু ।
চল মুনি চলি যাই, সেই মহাপ্রভু ঠাঁই,
সকল ভুবনে শিক্ষাগুরু ॥ ৫১৩ ॥

niścaẏa bacana mori, amāẏā se gaurahari,
prakaṭa karuṇā-kalpataru |
cala muni cali yāi, sei mahāprabhu ṭhāṁi,
sakala bhubane śikṣāguru || 513 ||

nishchaya vachana mori — firm is My word; amaya — without guile; se gaurahari — that Gaurahari; prakata karuna-kalpataru — the manifest wish-tree of mercy; chala muni chali yai — go, sage, go; sei mahaprabhu thani — to that Mahaprabhu; sakala bhuvane shiksha-guru — teacher of all the worlds

513Firm is My word, without guile: Gaurahari
is the manifest wish-fulfilling tree of mercy.
Go, sage, go to that Mahaprabhu,
the teacher of all the worlds."

চলিলা মুনীন্দ্ররায়, বীণা হরিগুণ গায়,
আনন্দে অবশ অঙ্গ কাঁপে ।
পুলকিত সব গা, আপাদ-মস্তক যা,
প্রেমবারি দুনয়নে ঝাঁপে ॥ ৫১৪ ॥

calilā munīndrarāẏa, bīṇā hariguṇa gāẏa,
ānande abaśa aṅga kāṁpe |
pulakita saba gā, āpāda-mastaka yā,
premabāri dunaẏane jhāṁpe || 514 ||

chalila munindraraya — the king of sages set out; vina hari-guna gaya — the vina sings Hari's virtues; anande avasha anga kanpe — the body, helpless with bliss, trembles; pulakita saba ga — the whole body thrills; apada-mastaka ya — from foot to head; prema-vari dunayane jhanpe — tears of prema flood both eyes

514The king of sages set out, his vina singing Hari's virtues,
his body, helpless with bliss, trembling;
his whole frame thrilled, from foot to head,
tears of prema flooding both his eyes.

প্রেমমদে মাতোয়ার, ক্ষণে হয় চমৎকার,
ক্ষণে ডাকে গৌরাঙ্গ বলিয়া ।
ক্ষণে আধ-পদ যায়, ক্ষণে ফিরি ফিরি চায়,
ক্ষণে কান্দে ক্ষণে চলে ধাঞা ॥ ৫১৫ ॥

premamade mātoẏāra, kṣaṇe haẏa camatkāra,
kṣaṇe ḍāke gaurāṅga baliẏā |
kṣaṇe ādha-pada yāẏa, kṣaṇe phiri phiri cāẏa,
kṣaṇe kānde kṣaṇe cale dhāñā || 515 ||

prema-made matoyara — drunk with the wine of prema; kshane haya chamatkara — now he is amazed; kshane dake gauranga baliya — now calls out "Gauranga!"; kshane adha-pada yaya — now goes half a step; kshane phiri phiri chaya — now looks back again and again; kshane kande kshane chale dhana — now weeps, now runs on

515Drunk with the wine of prema, now he is amazed,
now he calls out "Gauranga!",
now he goes half a step, now looks back again and again,
now he weeps, now he runs on.

আচম্বিতে বায়ু বহে, জুড়ায় সকল দেহে,
কোটি চাঁদ জিনি যেন জ্যোতিঃ ।
শ্রীপাদপদ্ম-গন্ধে, আউলায় শরীরবন্ধে,
যে দেখিয়ে তঁহি কাম-কীর্তি ॥ ৫১৬ ॥

ācambite bāẏu bahe, juṛāẏa sakala dehe,
koṭi cāṁda jini yena jyotiḥ |
śrīpādapadma-gandhe, āulāẏa śarīrabandhe,
ye dekhiẏe taṁhi kāma-kīrti || 516 ||

achambite vayu vahe — suddenly a breeze blows; judaya sakala dehe — cooling the whole body; koti chanda jini yena jyotih — a radiance as if surpassing millions of moons; shri-pada-padma-gandhe — with the fragrance of the lotus feet; aulaya sharira-bandhe — the body's bonds grow loose; ye dekhiye tanhi — whatever one sees there; kama-kirti — the glory of Kama

516Suddenly a breeze blew, cooling the whole body;
a radiance as if surpassing millions of moons;
with the fragrance of the lotus feet the body's bonds grow loose;
whatever one sees there is the glory of Kama.16

অনেক মদনরায়, অনুগত কাজে ধায়,
প্রেম বিনু না দেখিয়ে লোক ।
না দিবা-রজনী জানি, না দেখিয়ে ভিনাভিনি,
সর্বজন হরিষ অশোক ॥ ৫১৭ ॥

aneka madanarāẏa, anugata kāje dhāẏa,
prema binu nā dekhiẏe loka |
nā dibā-rajanī jāni, nā dekhiẏe bhinābhini,
sarbajana hariṣa aśoka || 517 ||

aneka madana-raya — many Madanas; anugata kaje dhaya — run obediently to serve; prema vinu na dekhiye loka — no one is seen without prema; na diva-rajani jani — no knowing of day or night; na dekhiye bhinabhini — no seeing of "mine" and "another's"; sarvajana harisha ashoka — all joyful, without sorrow

517Many Madanas run obediently to serve;
one sees no one there without prema;
there is no knowing of day or night, no seeing of "mine" and "another's";
all are joyful, without sorrow.

গমন নটনলীলা, বচন সঙ্গীতকলা,
নয়ান-চাহনি আকর্ষণ ।
রঙ্গ বিনু নাহি ভঙ্গ, ভাব বিনু নাহি সঙ্গ,
রসময় দেহের গঠন ॥ ৫১৮ ॥

gamana naṭanalīlā, bacana saṅgītakalā,
naẏāna-cāhani ākarṣaṇa |
raṅga binu nāhi bhaṅga, bhāba binu nāhi saṅga,
rasamaẏa dehera gaṭhana || 518 ||

gamana natana-lila — walking is the play of dance; vachana sangita-kala — speech is the art of music; nayana-chahani akarshana — a glance of the eyes is attraction; ranga vinu nahi bhanga — no movement without play; bhava vinu nahi sanga — no companionship without bhava; rasamaya dehera gathana — bodies formed of rasa

518Walking is the play of dance, speech the art of music,
a glance of the eyes is attraction;
there is no movement without play, no companionship without bhava;
the bodies there are formed of rasa.

তনু চিদানন্দময়, ভূমি চিন্তামণি হয়,
কল্পতরু সর্বতরু তথা ।
সুরভি যতেক সব, কামধেনু যেন নব,
উদ্ধবাদির আশ গুল্মলতা ॥ ৫১৯ ॥

tanu cidānandamaẏa, bhūmi cintāmaṇi haẏa,
kalpataru sarbataru tathā |
surabhi yateka saba, kāmadhenu yena naba,
uddhabādira āśa gulmalatā || 519 ||

tanu chidanandamaya — bodies of consciousness and bliss; bhumi chintamani haya — the ground is chintamani; kalpataru sarvataru tatha — all trees there are wish-fulfilling trees; surabhi yateka saba — all the cows; kamadhenu yena nava — like new kamadhenus; uddhavadira asha gulma-lata — the bushes and creepers are the longing of Uddhava and others

519Bodies are of consciousness and bliss, the ground is chintamani,
all the trees there are wish-fulfilling trees,
all the cows are like new kamadhenus,
the bushes and creepers are what Uddhava and others long for.

সব তরু কল্পদ্রুম, তঁহি এক নিরুপম,
রত্নবেদী তার দুই পাশে ।
স্বর্ণ-সিংহাসন তায়, বসিয়া গৌরাঙ্গরায়,
সরস মধুর লহু হাসে ॥ ৫২০ ॥

saba taru kalpadruma, taṁhi eka nirupama,
ratnabedī tāra dui pāśe |
sbarṇa-siṃhāsana tāẏa, basiẏā gaurāṅgarāẏa,
sarasa madhura lahu hāse || 520 ||

saba taru kalpadruma — all trees are wish-trees; tanhi eka nirupama — among them one beyond compare; ratna-vedi tara dui pashe — jewelled altars on both its sides; svarna-simhasana taya — on it a golden throne; basiya gaurangaraya — seated, Lord Gauranga; sarasa madhura lahu hase — sweetly, tenderly, softly smiles

520All the trees are wish-fulfilling trees; among them is one beyond compare,
with jewelled altars on both sides;
on it a golden throne, where Lord Gauranga sits
and sweetly, tenderly, softly smiles.

সশাখ মঙ্গলঘটে, সিংহাসন-সুনিকটে,
বামপদাঙ্গুষ্ঠ পরশিয়া ।
রতনপ্রদীপ জ্বলে, যেন দিবাকর-করে,
আলোকিত জগত ভরিয়া ॥ ৫২১ ॥

saśākha maṅgalaghaṭe, siṃhāsana-sunikaṭe,
bāmapadāṅguṣṭha paraśiẏā |
ratanapradīpa jbale, yena dibākara-kare,
ālokita jagata bhariẏā || 521 ||

sashakha mangala-ghate — an auspicious pot with twigs; simhasana-sunikate — right by the throne; vama-padangushtha parashiya — touching the great toe of the left foot; ratana-pradipa jvale — jewelled lamps burn; yena divakara-kare — as if with the sun's rays; alokita jagata bhariya — illuminating and filling the world

521An auspicious pot with [mango] twigs right by the throne
touches the great toe of His left foot;
jewelled lamps burn, as if with the rays of the sun,
illuminating and filling the world.

রাধিকা দক্ষিণপাশে, অনুচরী করি কাছে,
রত্ন-কলস করি করে ।
বামপাশে রুক্মিণী, কাছে করি সঙ্গিনী,
স্বর্ণঘটে রত্নজল ভরে ॥ ৫২২ ॥

rādhikā dakṣiṇapāśe, anucarī kari kāche,
ratna-kalasa kari kare |
bāmapāśe rukmiṇī, kāche kari saṅginī,
sbarṇaghaṭe ratnajala bhare || 522 ||

radhika dakshina-pashe — Radhika on the right; anuchari kari kachhe — keeping maidservants near; ratna-kalasa kari kare — a jewelled pitcher in hand; vama-pashe rukmini — Rukmini on the left; kachhe kari sangini — keeping companions near; svarna-ghate ratna-jala bhare — fills a golden pot with jewel-bright water

522Radhika on the right, keeping Her maidservants near,
a jewelled pitcher in Her hand;
on the left Rukmini, keeping her companions near,
fills a golden pot with water bright as jewels.17

নগ্নজিতা জল ভরে, দেই মিত্রবৃন্দা-করে,
মিত্রবৃন্দা সুলক্ষণা-করে ।
সে দেই রুক্মিণী-হাথে, দেবী ঢালে প্রভু-মাথে,
অভিষেক সুরনদী-জলে ॥ ৫২৩ ॥

nagnajitā jala bhare, dei mitrabṛndā-kare,
mitrabṛndā sulakṣaṇā-kare |
se dei rukmiṇī-hāthe, debī ḍhāle prabhu-māthe,
abhiṣeka suranadī-jale || 523 ||

nagnajita jala bhare — Nagnajiti draws water; dei mitravrinda-kare — gives into Mitravinda's hands; mitravrinda sulakshana-kare — Mitravinda into Sulakshana's hands; se dei rukmini-hathe — she gives into Rukmini's hands; devi dhale prabhu-mathe — the goddess pours on the Lord's head; abhisheka suranadi-jale — a bathing with the water of the heavenly river

523Nagnajiti draws water and gives it into Mitravinda's hands,
Mitravinda into Sulakshana's hands,
she gives it into Rukmini's hands, and the goddess pours it on the Lord's head —
a bathing with the water of the heavenly river.

তিলোত্তমা জল ভরে, দেই মধুপ্রিয়া-করে,
মধুপ্রিয়া চন্দ্রমুখী-করে ।
সে দেই রাধিকা-হাথে, রাই ঢালে প্রভু-মাথে,
অভিষেক করে গঙ্গাজলে ॥ ৫২৪ ॥

tilottamā jala bhare, dei madhupriẏā-kare,
madhupriẏā candramukhī-kare |
se dei rādhikā-hāthe, rāi ḍhāle prabhu-māthe,
abhiṣeka kare gaṅgājale || 524 ||

tilottama jala bhare — Tilottama draws water; dei madhupriya-kare — gives into Madhupriya's hands; madhupriya chandramukhi-kare — Madhupriya into Chandramukhi's hands; se dei radhika-hathe — she gives into Radhika's hands; rai dhale prabhu-mathe — Rai pours on the Lord's head; abhisheka kare ganga-jale — performs the bathing with Ganga water

524Tilottama draws water and gives it into Madhupriya's hands,
Madhupriya into Chandramukhi's hands,
she gives it into Radhika's hands, and Rai pours it on the Lord's head —
a bathing with the water of the Ganga.

সত্যভামা অন্তরে, দিব্য গন্ধ করি করে,
দিব্য মাল্য বস্ত্র অলঙ্কার ।
লক্ষণা সুভদ্রা ভদ্রা, সত্যভামা-পরতন্ত্রা,
অনুক্রমে করে দেই তার ॥ ৫২৫ ॥

satyabhāmā antare, dibya gandha kari kare,
dibya mālya bastra alaṅkāra |
lakṣaṇā subhadrā bhadrā, satyabhāmā-paratantrā,
anukrame kare dei tāra || 525 ||

satyabhama antare — Satyabhama near; divya gandha kari kare — holding divine scents in her hands; divya malya vastra alankara — divine garlands, garments, ornaments; lakshana subhadra bhadra — Lakshmana, Subhadra, Bhadra; satyabhama-paratantra — obedient to Satyabhama; anukrame kare dei tara — in turn give into her hands

525Satyabhama is near, holding divine scents in her hands,
divine garlands, garments and ornaments;
Lakshmana, Subhadra and Bhadra, obedient to Satyabhama,
in turn hand [everything] to her.

আর দিব্য নারী যত, চারি-পাশে শত শত,
দিব্য ভূষা দিব্য উপহার ।
রতনস্তবক করে, রহে প্রভু বরাবরে,
জয় জয় মঙ্গল-উচ্চার ॥ ৫২৬ ॥

āra dibya nārī yata, cāri-pāśe śata śata,
dibya bhūṣā dibya upahāra |
ratanastabaka kare, rahe prabhu barābare,
jaẏa jaẏa maṅgala-uccāra || 526 ||

ara divya nari yata — and all the other divine women; chari-pashe shata shata — by hundreds on every side; divya bhusha divya upahara — divine ornaments, divine gifts; ratana-stavaka kare — jewelled bouquets in hand; rahe prabhu barabare — stand before the Lord; jaya jaya mangala-uchchara — crying the auspicious "jaya, jaya"

526And all the other divine women, by hundreds on every side,
with divine ornaments and divine gifts,
holding jewelled bouquets, stand before the Lord,
crying the auspicious "Jaya, jaya!"

গোলোকনাথের স্নান, ইহা বহি নাহি আন,
আগমে কহিল মহাধ্যান ।
হেমগৌর কলেবর, মন্ত্র চারি অক্ষর,
সহজ বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ শ্যাম ॥ ৫২৭ ॥

golokanāthera snāna, ihā bahi nāhi āna,
āgame kahila mahādhyāna |
hemagaura kalebara, mantra cāri akṣara,
sahaja baikuṇṭhanātha śyāma || 527 ||

golokanathera snana — the bathing of the Lord of Goloka; iha bahi nahi ana — there is no other than this; agame kahila maha-dhyana — the Agamas told the great meditation; hema-gaura kalevara — a body golden-fair; mantra chari akshara — a mantra of four syllables; sahaja vaikunthanatha shyama — the Lord of Vaikuntha is by nature dark

527Such is the bathing of the Lord of Goloka — there is no other;
the Agamas have told the great meditation [on Him]:
a body golden-fair, a mantra of four syllables;18
the Lord of Vaikuntha is by nature dark.

শ্যাম-দেহে চারি হাথ, ধরয়ে বৈকুণ্ঠনাথ,
চারি হস্তে চারি অস্ত্র তার ।
হেম-কিরণিয়া পহুঁ, হেম-অঙ্গে হাসে লহুঁ,
দ্বিভুজ শরীর শুন সার ॥ ৫২৮ ॥

śyāma-dehe cāri hātha, dharaẏe baikuṇṭhanātha,
cāri haste cāri astra tāra |
hema-kiraṇiẏā pahuṁ, hema-aṅge hāse lahuṁ,
dbibhuja śarīra śuna sāra || 528 ||

shyama-dehe chari hatha — a dark body with four arms; dharaye vaikunthanatha — has the Lord of Vaikuntha; chari haste chari astra tara — in four hands His four weapons; hema-kiraniya panhu — the Lord radiant with gold; hema-ange hase lahu — golden-limbed, softly smiles; dvibhuja sharira — a two-armed body; shuna sara — hear the essence

528A dark body with four arms has the Lord of Vaikuntha,
in His four hands four weapons;
but the Lord radiant with gold, golden-limbed, softly smiles —
hear the essence: His body is two-armed.

এছন সময়ে মুনি, দেখি গোরা গুণমণি,
বিভোর পড়িল পদতলে ।
আঁখি মিলিবারে নারে, পুনঃ চাহে দেখিবারে,
সিনাইল নয়নের জলে ॥ ৫২৯ ॥

echana samaẏe muni, dekhi gorā guṇamaṇi,
bibhora paṛila padatale |
āṁkhi milibāre nāre, punaḥ cāhe dekhibāre,
sināila naẏanera jale || 529 ||

aichhana samaye muni — at that moment the sage; dekhi gora gunamani — seeing Gora, the Jewel of virtues; vibhora padila padatale — fell enraptured at the feet; ankhi milibare nare — cannot open his eyes; punah chahe dekhibare — again longs to look; sinaila nayanera jale — bathed [Him] with the tears of his eyes

529At that moment the sage, seeing Gora, the Jewel of virtues,
fell enraptured at His feet;
he cannot open his eyes — and again he longs to look;
he bathed [Him] with the tears of his eyes.

স্নান সমাপিয়া পহুঁ, হাসি কহে লহু লহু,
নারদ তুলিয়া লৈল কোলে ।
ঘুচিল সংশয় চিন্তা, খণ্ডিল মনের ব্যথা,
প্রভু প্রিয় লহু লহু বোলে ॥ ৫৩০ ॥

snāna samāpiẏā pahuṁ, hāsi kahe lahu lahu,
nārada tuliẏā laila kole |
ghucila saṃśaẏa cintā, khaṇḍila manera byathā,
prabhu priẏa lahu lahu bole || 530 ||

snana samapiya panhu — the Lord, having finished His bath; hasi kahe lahu lahu — smiling, speaking very softly; narada tuliya laila kole — lifted Narada and took him on His lap; ghuchila samshaya chinta — doubts and anxieties went; khandila manera vyatha — the pain of the heart was broken; prabhu priya lahu lahu bole — the Lord very softly speaks loving words

530Having finished His bath, the Lord, smiling, speaking very softly,
lifted Narada up and took him on His lap;
doubt and anxiety went, the pain of his heart was broken;
the Lord speaks loving words very softly.

✦

Notes

  1. That is, worldly people, judging by appearances, see in the gopis' love for Krishna only a breach of marital fidelity. The Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following the Bhagavata (10.33.26–39) and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4), teach that the gopis' parakiya-rasa is the purest prema, wholly unlike worldly passion; Lochana Dasa himself says that by this prema the Lord is conquered.
  2. The words of Uddhava. In the edition the verse is followed by Bhaktisiddhanta's anvaya and translation: "Oh! The gopis in Vrindavana, abandoning kinsmen hard to abandon — husbands, fathers-in-law and others — and the path of dharma, served the lotus feet of Mukunda, which the Vedas seek. Shall I obtain any birth at all in Vrindavana among the bushes, creepers and herbs that serve the dust of the gopis' feet?"
  3. An echo of the Bhagavata (10.47.59), where Uddhava says: "Where are these forest women, tainted by infidelity, and where is this love for Krishna, the Supreme Self!" — to show that such love is given irrespective of merit. The words "unchaste", "lustful" express the worldly view; in the Gaudiya understanding the kama of the gopis is pure prema, whose only desire is Krishna's joy (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4.164–171).
  4. The raga and disha are given after the 1983 edition; in A the line is illegible.
  5. A has the past tense ("has taken birth"); the 1983 edition the future ("will take birth"), as also in v. 474.
  6. The 1983 edition has four couplets here: people have abandoned charity, vows and austerity and toil only for the belly; brahmanas have abandoned the worship of Krishna, and kshatriyas, vaishyas and shudras the service of brahmanas; abandoning respect for father and mother, all honour their wives with body, speech and mind. A has a single couplet (from the first and last lines).
  7. Daru-brahman, "Brahman in wood": the Lord Himself, manifest in the wooden Deity of Jagannatha at Puri (Nilachala).
  8. See vv. 257–271: the Lord promised Katyayani (Parvati) to fulfil her vow concerning mahaprasada and to appear in Kali as Gaura; Narada then proclaimed this at His command.
  9. So Lochana Dasa: in Goloka, the highest abode above Vaikuntha, Gaurasundara Himself is king. In the Gaudiya Vaishnava understanding (Bhaktivinoda Thakura, Bhaktisiddhanta) Gaura's abode, Navadvipa-dhama, is non-different from Goloka-Vrindavana and is part of it; Gaura is Krishna Himself with the bhava and lustre of Radha.
  10. Lochana Dasa sets side by side Radha (source of the gopis) and Rukmini (source of the queens of Dvaraka). The Gaudiya Vaishnavas, following the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 4.75–81), teach that Radha is the original hladini-shakti and the source of all the Lord's beloveds: the Lakshmis of Vaikuntha, the queens of Dvaraka and the gopis.
  11. The subject of the stanza is not named; probably the description of Satyabhama as the embodiment of music continues — or the deity of music is introduced as another dweller of Goloka.
  12. Perhaps "Ranga" ("Play") is the name of the city; it may also be understood as "the city full of rasa and play".
  13. Maya here is His energy, not an illusion that rules Him; the "reflections" (chhaya) are His expansions. The expression is Lochana Dasa's own; in Gaudiya theology all avataras are portions and parts (amsha, kala) of Krishna (Bhag. 1.3.28). In the 1983 edition the second half of the stanza reads: "…hundreds of avataras — He alone is the merciful King".
  14. This stanza (like the previous one) differs in the 1983 edition: "I, Vishnu, am His reflection (chhaya), Lakshmi the reflection of [His] wealth, this Vaikuntha the reflection of [His] Vaikuntha"; we follow A ("portion"). The thought agrees with Gaudiya teaching: Narayana of Vaikuntha is a vilasa expansion of Krishna, and Vaikuntha an expansion of Goloka (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 5). Line 3 is obscure; the 1983 edition has "all, established in bhakti, serve…".
  15. Lines 3–4 are obscure; perhaps the "three qualities of shakti" are the Lord's three energies: hladini, sandhini and samvit (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 4.62). In the 1983 edition line 3 differs: "prakriti on the right and left, named Lalita and Vishakha".
  16. Kama (Madana) is the god of love. Here not the worldly Cupid is meant: the spiritual beauty of Goloka is described, where, in the words of the Gaudiya scriptures, Krishna (and Gaura) is aprakrita-Madana, the transcendental Cupid who enchants Cupid himself.
  17. The bathing (abhisheka) of Gaura in Goloka. Among those taking part are queens of Dvaraka (Rukmini, Satyabhama, Nagnajiti, Mitravinda, Lakshmana-Sulakshana, Bhadra), Radhika and companions from Vraja (Chandramukhi, Madhupriya), and Tilottama; Lochana Dasa unites the consorts of Dvaraka and Vraja in one vision.
  18. Which four-syllable mantra is meant the author does not say.
